changelog: **Bug reports, phase 3: notifications, GitHub issues, retention (#3132):** a new in-app report is announced to the org's admins after the response (`after()`) — by e-mail through `sendEmail()` (new category `support-report`, group `inbound_requests`) and/or a Slack incoming webhook (`SUPPORT_REPORT_NOTIFY` = `email` default | `slack` | `both` | `off`, `SUPPORT_REPORT_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` must be a `hooks.slack.com` URL and passes the SSRF guard; Slack without one falls back to e-mail). The admin detail gets **Create GitHub issue** (`SUPPORT_GITHUB_REPO` + server secret `SUPPORT_GITHUB_TOKEN`): a draft that is public-safe by construction (`buildIssueDraft()` — page path, build, browser, counts, failed-request ids, a relative admin link; never the description, reporter, e-mail, console text, host, screenshot or replay), shown in full and editable with a public-repo warning; one issue per report via a conditional `pending:` claim, released on a GitHub failure; only `https://github.com/<repo>/issues/<n>` is stored in `githubIssueUrl`. Status changes can tell the reporter (category `support-report-update`, group `direct_messages`, held like a message under outbound approval) only when they allowed contact (`409 contact_not_allowed` otherwise). New retention entry `supportReport`, 90 days (global setting `supportReportRetentionDays`), files cascade. Pure rules in `src/lib/supportReportIntegrationRule.ts`; e2e against a local GitHub stand-in (`e2e/support/github-mock.mjs`).

en: When you send a bug report and allow us to contact you, the support team can now let you know by e-mail once it is being worked on or fixed.
tr: Bir hata bildirimi gönderip iletişime izin verdiğinde, destek ekibi artık üzerinde çalışılmaya başlandığında ya da düzeltildiğinde sana e-postayla haber verebiliyor.
de: Wenn du eine Fehlermeldung sendest und eine Kontaktaufnahme erlaubst, kann dich das Support-Team jetzt per E-Mail informieren, sobald daran gearbeitet wird oder sie behoben ist.
